{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-3thrsy",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Crew U-A/U-B collected work folder and lock equipment at 09:35 (supported). C-11 RUN is a running-status bit, not proof of flow or compressor operation. The pressure drop occurred downstream of P-U while upstream remained stable.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If C-11 RUN were a local flow proof, the pressure drop would be inconsistent with upstream stability.",
      "competingExplanation": "C-11 RUN is explicitly defined as not being a local flow proof; thus its state does not establish compressor operation or failure at that moment.","evidenceGap":"No evidence links C-11 RUN status to actual air supply interruption mechanism. Need point register mapping for AL-44 input and valve states if any exist in records."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-jg4jvc",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No evidence of breakdown in communication between Utilities and RHOB regarding air-low indication. This may have contributed to delayed response or misinterpretation.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["q-isvv2m"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If clear communication existed, the event might still occur but with better situational awareness and faster mitigation.",
      "competingExplanation": "Communication breakdown is hypothesized; no direct evidence of message failure or misinterpretation exists in current records.","evidenceGap":"Need explicit record of any radio/phone call logs between Utilities and RHOB at 10:00 AM to confirm communication status."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-8pkzru",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The specific equipment or process condition causing the air-low indication at RHOB P-R is unknown. This prevents identifying a direct physical cause.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a specific equipment failure (e.g., valve M-101) caused the drop, correcting that would prevent recurrence.","competingExplanation":"Multiple possible causes exist: upstream supply issue, distribution leak, or downstream blockage. Current evidence does not distinguish among them.","evidenceGap":"Need detailed pressure trace and alarm input mapping to identify exact location of failure."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lde5sa",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No evidence of documented confirmation between Utilities and RHOB that air-low alarm was understood. This may have contributed to delayed recognition or response.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["q-8irrr9"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If such documentation existed, it might indicate proper training and awareness of the alarm's significance.","competingExplanation":"Absence of documented confirmation does not prove lack of understanding; may be an evidence gap rather than a causal factor.","evidenceGap":"Need witness statements or logs confirming whether RHOB operators were trained on AL-44 behavior."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-oigq1p",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Work package cover indicates temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time. This may indicate incomplete documentation or missing procedural steps.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the field had been filled, it might indicate proper preparation and authorization for maintenance.","competingExplanation":"Blank fields may be due to oversight or system limitations rather than procedural violation. Need evidence of required attachments per procedure.","evidenceGap":"Need work package template requirements document to determine if blank attachment is a compliance issue."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Pressure drop occurred only at P-R (RHOB receiving header) while upstream P-U remained normal (~6.9 bar), indicating a localized issue downstream of the North gallery or within the RHOB distribution path.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the issue were upstream, both P-U and P-R would show pressure drops.","competingExplanation":"Localized failure in RHOB distribution path is supported by data; no competing explanation currently exists.","evidenceGap":"Need valve state records or flow measurements to pinpoint exact location of failure."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-17qciec",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Shift log IA-S01 records 'boundary preparation in progress' but does not identify point of interruption or valve states. This may indicate incomplete situational awareness.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the log had identified valve states, it might have helped isolate the cause faster.","competingExplanation":"Log limitations are known; absence of detail does not prove procedural failure but indicates evidence gap.","evidenceGap":"Need detailed shift notes or operator logs to determine if boundary preparation was complete."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-177jnpq",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Point register IA-P02 does not establish state of any distribution valve. This limits ability to determine if a valve was open or closed during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If point register established valve states, it might have revealed if a valve was inadvertently open.","competingExplanation":"Point register limitations are documented; absence of state data is expected and not evidence of failure.","evidenceGap":"Need alternative method to determine valve positions (e.g., field inspection or SCADA logs)."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1w3niil",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Area directory IA-D01 does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time. This limits ability to determine if a valve was open or closed during the event.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If area directory established valve positions, it might have revealed if a valve was inadvertently open.","competingExplanation":"Area directory limitations are documented; absence of state data is expected and not evidence of failure.","evidenceGap":"Need alternative method to determine valve positions (e.g., field inspection or SCADA logs)."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1sd8vsk",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Pressure extract IA-P01 provides sampled values only (not continuous) and excludes data from all locations or valve states. This limits ability to determine exact timing and scope of pressure drop.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If continuous data were available, it might have revealed exact timing and scope of pressure drop.","competingExplanation":"Sampling limitations are documented; absence of continuous data is expected and not evidence of failure.","evidenceGap":"Need alternative method to determine exact timing (e.g., alarm logs or operator notes)."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1qy43nt",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Utilities acknowledged receipt and paused work at ~10:02 AM. This indicates response to the event but does not explain cause.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If Utilities had not paused work, the event might have led to equipment damage or safety incident.","competingExplanation":"Response action is appropriate; does not explain cause of pressure drop.","evidenceGap":"Need evidence of why pause was necessary (e.g., alarm acknowledgment)."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-8fwh2r",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Pressure restored to normal levels around 10:06 AM. This indicates resolution but does not explain cause.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If pressure had not restored, the event might have led to equipment damage or safety incident.","competingExplanation":"Resolution is appropriate; does not explain cause of pressure drop.","evidenceGap":"Need evidence of how pressure was restored (e.g., valve operation)."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The causal graph identifies multiple unknowns and gaps in the current evidence. The primary event (pressure drop at P-R) has several contributing factors, including communication breakdown, incomplete documentation, and lack of continuous data. However, no single root cause can be identified without additional evidence.","evidenceUsed":["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],"unknowns":["Exact location of pressure drop origin (upstream, downstream, or within distribution network)","Valve states during the event","Communication breakdown between Utilities and RHOB","Documentation completeness for work package WO-527"],"alternatives":["Upstream supply failure","Distribution system leak","Downstream blockage","Equipment malfunction at P-R station"],"confidence":0.6},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId=req-1a",
    "sourceId=","claimRef"
  ]}
